text:
Maria L: Quick sync — NovaBank is asking if we can be a drop-in for their current vendor. Main asks: identical response schema (they rely on `response_format`), predictable latency for sync endpoints, KMS/HSM for keys, and a pricing comparison for token accounting. POC starts Mon.
Kevin T: Do we have a documented mapping from their fields to ours? e.g., they use `response_format: structured_v1` + `max_chunks`, and expect a `metadata.trace_id` in outputs.
Arjun S: No direct mapping doc yet. We do support structured outputs and function-calling, but the field names differ. I can draft a small shim mapping. Also note their API pads tokens; billing equivalence isn't 1:1.
Ben R: For presales: need a short bulleted sheet comparing cost assumptions (their billed tokens vs our tokenization), and an example prompt/response parity test we can run.
Priya N: Security asks: customer wants KMS with key wrapping and HSM-backed signing, plus SOC2/ISO artifacts. Can security-bot confirm our out-of-the-box posture?
security-bot: Redwood standard: KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure), optional HSM via partner HSM-for-VPC. SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 available. Need customer LOA for on-prem key import. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Maria L: OK — immediate action items before POC:
- Arjun: provide a 1-page mapping and a minimal shim example by EOD Thu.
- Kevin/Ben: pricing delta doc + example tokenized prompt/response by Fri.
- Priya/Security: confirmation on KMS/HSM and a short note on data residency + LOA process.
Arjun S: Draft shim snippet — mapping competitor -> Redwood API:
```
# competitor request
{ "response_format": "structured_v1", "prompt": "...", "max_chunks": 3 }
# shim maps to
{ "mode": "structured", "prompt": "...\n--compat:structured_v1", "max_output_chunks": 3 }
# also add metadata.trace_id -> response.metadata.trace_id
```
Arjun S: Note: we add a compatibility prefix to prompt so model behavior matches their fine-tuned prompts. This preserves intent but may change token counts.
Kevin T: For pricing, remind sales: competitor charges per 'chunk' not tokens; their chunk size is 1k bytes in their docs. We'll show a tokenized sample for 3 representative prompts: short, medium, long.
Ben R: Also flag enterprise blocker: NovaBank requires SLAs for 99.95% availability and an auditable rollback plan during model rollouts. Can we offer that on Dedicated or Private? Priest?
Priya N: We can offer 99.95 on Dedicated with contract. Private (VPC/on-prem) gives the strongest audit controls. Need legal to draft SLA addendum.
Maria L: POC logistics: they want a minimal compatibility endpoint in our staging org. Arjun can we stand that up as an alias + route policy to a compat shim container?
Arjun S: Yes. I propose a lightweight shim container that rewrites incoming competitor fields -> Redwood and calls the underlying model. Will instrument latency and token deltas. Expected extra tail latency ~30-60ms.
security-bot: Reminder: for staging with client data, ensure customer signs the POC DPA and we enable encryption at rest + KMS keys scoped to their org.
Kevin T: I'll prepare the pricing sheet and include two scenarios: hosted (usage pricing with token delta adjustment) and Dedicated (flat monthly + overage). Will include ballpark numbers.
Ben R: Can one of you provide 3 sample responses (parity test) we can run through their clients' integration? They want to run end-to-end before signing.
Arjun S: I'll produce 3 sample prompts and the Redwood responses (and the shim'd competitor-equivalent requests) by Fri afternoon. They can run them and compare diffs.
Maria L: Thanks team. I'll consolidate notes and send the POC checklist to NovaBank after we have the mapping + security confirmation.
Kevin T: tagging @Ben R for pricing review when draft is done. :point_up:
Ben R: on it.
